empty.title: Your first campaign
empty.text: An INFLUX campaign describes what you offer to creators: the offer, the work expected, the audience aimed at, the budget and the calendar. It saves as you go, and an INFLUX account manager reviews it before it is published.

feed.title: Campaigns
feed.capReached: List limited: {count} campaigns shown out of {total}.

empty.title: No open campaign for now.
empty.text: Complete your profile: it is what an INFLUX account manager looks at when matching a brand with a creator.

feed.unavailable: We cannot show the campaigns right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
feed.forbidden: Campaigns are not available with the current state of your account.
feed.rateLimited: You are reading campaigns very often. Please try again in a moment.
feed.rateLimitedWait: You are reading campaigns very often. Please try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

usageRights.warning: What becomes of your content: the brand asks for media buying, with no time limit and worldwide. It may run the content as its own advertising, everywhere and without end. Make sure you have fully understood this.

disclosure.notice: Your post must state that it is commercial, under the rules of your country and of your audience's. INFLUX reminds you of this obligation without guaranteeing local compliance.

gone.title: This campaign is no longer open.
gone.text: It has closed, been paused or been withdrawn. Other campaigns are waiting for you.

record.unavailable: We cannot show this campaign right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
record.forbidden: Campaigns are not available with your account's current state.
record.rateLimited: You are reading campaigns very often. Please try again in a moment.
record.rateLimitedWait: You are reading campaigns very often. Please try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
record.noApplication: Applying is not available yet: this page lets you read the campaign.

home.title: My campaigns
home.text: Create a campaign, saved as you go, then submit it to an INFLUX account manager.

publish.title: Submit my campaign
publish.missing: {count, plural, one {# piece of information is} other {# pieces of information are}} missing to submit your campaign: {fields}.
publish.ready: All the required information is filled in: you can submit your campaign.
publish.explain: An INFLUX account manager reviews the campaign before it is published. Once submitted, it cannot be edited during the review.
publish.sensitiveNotice: This product category calls for an enhanced review, which may lengthen the review.
publish.declarationRequired: Tick this declaration to submit the campaign.
publish.submittedText: It cannot be edited during the review.
publish.unavailable: The campaign could not be submitted right now. Try again in a moment.
publish.unsaved: Your last entry is not saved yet. Wait for the save to finish, then submit again.
publish.invalid: First correct {count, plural, one {the field that was refused} other {the fields that were refused}}, then submit again:
publish.locked: This campaign can no longer be edited: it cannot be submitted again.
publish.profileRequired: Publish your brand profile before submitting a campaign.

budget.bandBrand: Budget band per creator: the total amount you pay, INFLUX commission included. Only your INFLUX account manager sees it.
budget.negotiate: To be negotiated with your account manager.
budget.internalPilot: Your budget is never published: only your INFLUX account manager sees it.
budget.giftOnly: Gifted product only: no budget band is asked. The value of the product is entered in step 1.
budget.creatorSees: A creator sees the nature of the compensation, followed by the line below. No amount and no band is shown to them.
budget.noNature: Choose the nature of the compensation: it will show here.

application.validationNotice: Applying does not open a conversation: the application is reviewed by an INFLUX account manager.

status.draft: Draft saved automatically. Nobody but you sees it until you submit it.
status.pending: Your campaign is being reviewed by the INFLUX team.
status.published: Your campaign is published: creators can read it.
status.paused: Campaign paused — applications are on hold.
status.rejectedNoReason: Your campaign was not published. Correct it, then submit it again.

rejection.contact_in_text: Your campaign contains an address, a number, a link or an invitation to contact you outside INFLUX.
rejection.amount_in_text: An amount appears in your text. Amounts are declared in the budget block, which is never published.
rejection.link_in_text: Links are not accepted in a campaign. Your website is already on your profile.
rejection.brief_insufficient: Your brief does not let a creator understand what you expect.
rejection.deliverables_inconsistent: The requested formats do not match the targeted networks.
rejection.budget_inconsistent: The declared budget band cannot be used as it stands.
rejection.calendar_invalid: The dates of your campaign are no longer valid.
rejection.creator_personal_criterion: Your campaign sets a criterion about the creator as a person (age, gender, appearance). Targeting is about the audience, never about the creator.
rejection.minor_audience: A campaign cannot target an audience under 18.
rejection.concealed_advertising: A campaign cannot ask for paid content to be presented as a spontaneous opinion.
rejection.duplicate: An identical campaign is already published.
rejection.sensitive_authorizations_missing: We could not verify your authorisations for this type of product.
rejection.illicit_content: Your campaign cannot be published: it is contrary to the law or to the INFLUX terms of use. The message from the INFLUX team:
rejection.other: Your campaign could not be published as it stands. The message from the INFLUX team:

refusal.fix: Correct your campaign from your INFLUX space, then submit it again.
refusal.contact: To discuss it, contact INFLUX from the help on the sign-in screen.

lifecycle.title: Campaign life
lifecycle.published: Your campaign is visible to creators. Paused, it no longer accepts applications; conversations already open are not affected.
lifecycle.paused: Your campaign is paused: it no longer accepts applications. Resume it whenever you like, with no new review.
lifecycle.closed: This campaign is over: it cannot be reopened.
lifecycle.closeWarning: Closing is final: the campaign can never be reopened, you can only create a new one. Nothing is erased and conversations already open are not affected.

done.pause: Campaign paused: it no longer accepts applications.
done.resume: Campaign resumed: it is published again.

failed.unavailable: This action could not be done. Try again in a moment.
failed.notAllowed: This action is no longer possible: the campaign changed state. Its current state is shown.
failed.pausedByInflux: This campaign was paused by the INFLUX team: only it can resume it. Contact it from the help on the sign-in screen.

form.unavailable: We cannot show this campaign right now. Try again in a few minutes.
form.locked: This campaign can no longer be edited: it is under review or already published.
form.intro: A campaign is the offer you make to creators. Start with the essentials: the rest can be completed later, everything is saved as you go.
form.stepMissing: {count, plural, =0 {everything is filled in} one {# piece of information to complete} other {# pieces of information to complete}}

1.title: The offer
1.question: What are you offering, and what is it about?

2.title: The work expected
2.question: What must the creator produce, and what will you do with it?

3.title: For whom
3.question: Which audience are you aiming at?

4.title: The budget
4.question: How much do you pay per creator, INFLUX commission included?

5.title: Calendar and application
5.question: When, and what must a creator send?

form.internalNotice: This box is never published: only you and your INFLUX account manager see it.

preview.title: What a creator sees
preview.banner: Preview: this is your campaign as a creator would see it, exactly as INFLUX presents it to them. Nothing is sent or published from this page.
preview.unavailable: We can't show this preview right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
preview.empty: Nothing to show yet: complete the steps of the campaign and the preview will follow.
preview.brandUnpublished: Your brand profile is not published yet: a creator would see neither your name nor your presentation.

save.retry: Changes not saved — new attempt in 5 s.
save.failedTitle: Your entry is not saved yet
save.failedText: It stays on this page: you can carry on. A new attempt is made in a few seconds.

title.label: Campaign title
title.help: Describe the offer, not the brand: your name is already on your profile. No amount, contact detail or link.

publicSummary.label: Public summary
publicSummary.help: What you are looking for, for whom and on which network. It is the only text read before the campaign is opened.

brief.label: Detailed brief
brief.help: The context, the creative expectations, the tone, what must appear and what is left free.

internalReference.label: Internal reference
internalReference.help: To tell your campaigns apart. It is never published.

productDescription.label: Product or service concerned
productDescription.help: A creator judges a campaign on the product, not on a sector.

keyMessages.label: Key messages
keyMessages.help: What you want to hear said, in one to five bullets of 10 to 200 characters. Recommended.

restrictions.label: Prohibitions and points of attention
restrictions.help: What you refuse to see: forbidden terms, competitors not to be named, claims not to be made. Never a criterion about the creator as a person.

productIsSent.label: Is a product sent to the creator?

currency.label: Campaign currency
currency.help: One currency for the whole campaign: it serves the value of the product and the budget.

productValueBand.label: Value of the product sent
productValueBand.help: As a band, never an exact value. Only your INFLUX account manager sees it.

creatorKeepsProduct.label: Does the creator keep the product?
creatorKeepsProduct.help: A product to be returned is not a payment.

deliverables.label: Deliverables
deliverables.help: A deliverable is a network, a format and a quantity: “2 stories + 1 reel” is not “3 pieces of content”. UGC formats (video, photo) are delivered to the brand, which publishes them itself.

contentReviewDelay.label: Time to review the content
contentReviewDelay.help: You commit to answer within this time. INFLUX does not receive or validate any deliverable.

audienceCountries.label: Countries aimed at
audienceCountries.help: The countries where the audience you aim at lives. It describes the audience, never the creator.

audienceBands.label: Audience size wished
audienceBands.help: As bands, never an exact number.

audienceAgeBands.label: Age bands of the audience
audienceAgeBands.help: No band under 18: INFLUX does not open this subject.

audienceGender.label: Gender split of the audience
audienceGender.help: Optional. It describes the audience, never the creator; without a choice, it is no preference.

creatorsWanted.label: Number of creators wanted
creatorsWanted.help: From {min} to {max}. Beyond that, a sales-assisted engagement fits better.

applicationsCloseOn.label: Application deadline
applicationsCloseOn.help: After this date the campaign no longer accepts applications, but stays readable.

contentDueOn.label: Content delivery date
contentDueOn.help: Recommended: what the creator must meet. It follows the application deadline.

endsOn.label: End of the publication period
endsOn.help: The publication period lasts 12 months at most.

requestedItems.label: Items you would like to find in an application
requestedItems.help: Optional. They guide the creator, and add or remove no field of their application.

maxApplications.label: Ceiling of applications
maxApplications.help: Optional, from {min} to {max}. Once reached, the campaign no longer accepts applications; the number received is never shown to creators.

fieldErrors.unknown: This choice is no longer available: pick another one.
fieldErrors.duplicate: The same network and the same format can only appear once: change the quantity.
fieldErrors.formatNetworkMismatch: This format does not belong to this network: pick a format of the network.
fieldErrors.ugcRequiresRights: Content delivered to the brand requires usage rights: choose them in step 2, or change the campaign type.
fieldErrors.giftRequiresProduct: This campaign offers a product: answer “yes” to a product being sent, or change the nature of the payment.
fieldErrors.notApplicable: This answer makes no sense with another one: check the neighbouring choices.
fieldErrors.dateOrder: This date does not follow the order of the calendar: check the four dates.
fieldErrors.windowTooLong: The publication period cannot exceed 12 months.
fieldErrors.required: To fill in or correct before submitting the campaign.

errors.contactInText: Your text contains what looks like direct contact details or an invitation to get in touch outside INFLUX.
errors.linkInText: Your text contains what looks like a link. Links are not accepted in a campaign: your brand's domain is already on your profile.
errors.amountInText: Your text contains an amount. Amounts belong in the budget section.

remuneration.affiliate: Affiliate: a share of the sales generated

usage_right.none: None: the content stays on the creator's account
usage_right.organic_repost: Organic repost: you republish the content on your own accounts, with no advertising budget
usage_right.paid_whitelisting: Paid whitelisting: you run paid advertising from the creator's account
usage_right.media_buy: Media buy: you run the content as your own advertising
